scope: Only the 797 object-relation view receipts are split by their explicit display_mode; the separate 29 crosswalk views are not added or relabeled.
located_candidate is source-informed localization of an annotation candidate; it does not certify a complete reading, month, date, or hand.
Target IDs/types/boxes quote source granularity; whole scenes, figures, animals and assemblies do not become equivalent roles.
Zero single_layout_candidate outside this joined set is a property of these frozen classifications, not proof of no historical text-image relation.
Partial graphic connection is not a semantic/linguistic link; no text score, image review or new translation.
